maria_support: FYI escalated ticket from AcmeCorp — they're getting intermittent parsing failures when using response_format=structured & strict=true. Started after the 2026-03-01 rollout. Customer says sometimes the client gets an HTML error page and strict mode rejects it (422/invalid json), sometimes it returns an auth 401. Repro steps below.

maria_support: CURL they used:
```
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?response_format=structured&strict=true" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-acme123" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"input":"summarize: include bullets"}'
```

maria_support: One raw response they logged (note Content-Type):
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
X-Request-ID: req_acme_01

<html><body>502 backend error</body></html>
```

alex_runtime: thanks. two quick asks — (1) can you paste the exact X-Request-ID and full raw headers for a failing request? (2) do they have any proxy/waf in front that could swap content-type?

maria_support: request id is `req_acme_01` plus I attached the edge log excerpt in the ticket. Customer is using their own API gateway but we've seen identical failures from their CI and from curl so I don't think it's on their side.

opsbot: [automated] edge-log 2026-03-05T14:12:07Z req_acme_01 -> upstream:502 timeout; origin returned HTML error page; backend-service=renderer-v2; region=us-west-2

sam_sre: this looks like CDN/edge replacing 5xx with HTML error pages. In normal (non-strict) mode the client code tolerates non-json, but in strict structured mode we should either return a JSON error object or a clear 4xx/5xx. We might have regressed and let the edge return raw HTML.

sam_sre: quick repro suggestion for eng: run the same curl but force low timeout to trigger upstream 502 and see if edge returns HTML. Also check `Accept` header behavior — some edges choose HTML when Accept includes `text/html` or missing.

maria_support: customer also reported some 401s intermittently — they included Authorization header in all attempts. They saw ~40 failed requests and 5 succeeded. Billing noticed multiple retries counted.

josh_billing: adding note — billing team opened case BILL-789, customer on Dedicated plan. We'll credit obvious retry spikes once root cause confirmed. Please tag billing with final fix eta.

alex_runtime: setting priority P1. I'm creating a runtime bug (RNF-1234) — suspected cause: content-negotiation middleware in front of the strict-json path returns edge/html for upstream 5xx instead of canonical error JSON. Immediate mitigation: (a) if customer can, have them add `Accept: application/json` and disable any intermediate proxy HTML-mangling; (b) they can set `strict=false` as a temporary workaround.

alex_runtime: requested artifacts: full raw request/response bytes, X-Cloud-Trace and X-Request-ID, and a replayable curl. I'll repro locally and if confirmed push small patch: when `response_format=structured` and `strict=true` enforce JSON error wrapper at the edge before any HTML passthrough.

maria_support: pasted raw headers from ticket:
```
Request: POST /v1/generate?response_format=structured&strict=true
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-acme123
Content-Type: application/json
User-Agent: acme-internal/1.2.3

Response (failing): HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
X-Request-ID: req_acme_01
X-Cloud-Trace: trace-abc-01

<html>...502...</html>
```

sam_sre: thanks — that's exactly the symptom. We should also investigate the auth 401s — could be token rotation on their side + retries hitting different edge nodes.

alex_runtime: I'll take ownership for the runtime fix. Plan: (1) reproduce with forced upstream 502, (2) patch edge handler to intercept non-application/json responses when `strict=true` and return structured JSON error: `{\"error\":{\"type\":\"upstream_error\",\"message\":...}}` and propagate original status. (3) add guardrails/telemetry to surface content-type mismatches to support.

alex_runtime: ETA for hotfix (canary -> global): 4 hours if reproduces cleanly, otherwise EOD. I'll update RNF-1234.

maria_support: I'll reply to customer with workaround instructions (use Accept: application/json or set strict=false, and we'll follow up after patch). I'll also attach the X-Request-ID and billing case.

josh_billing: pls @alex_runtime let us know final commit/PR so we can give the customer a timeline for credits.

alex_runtime: will do. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre to help with repro and edge config review.

maria_support: thanks team — keeping customer updated, will post any new failing request ids here. :thumbsup:
